::: {.entry}
[Gilles Castel](https://castel.dev/)\
Gilles was a legendary liveTeXer with a lecture note setup 10x more impressive than mine. He has excellent tutorials on his website, alongside all of his sourcecode. He sadly passed away in 2022.
:::
